answer: Gate each epoch's reward behind a verifiable delay function — a strictly sequential computation that must run wall-clock time and cannot be split across cores or clones. One honest agent runs one delay and is done, a smooth velvet pass. A farm cannot parallelize: each clone must wander the full sequential ridge from start to finished proof alone, so a thousand accounts means a thousand real-time delays end to end, with no shortcut from throwing more machines at it. Wall-clock time per identity, not raw horsepower, is the wall the swarm cannot scale.
